prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and intermittent numbness radiating into the upper arm. Initial examination showed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and positive impingement signs. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture or dislocation, with findings consistent with soft tissue strain and mild rotator cuff irritation.

Treatment consisted of a structured course of physical therapy combined with a home exercise program, activity modification, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. The patient attended 18 visits over the course of care. Progress was gradual, with pain scores decreasing steadily and functional range of motion improving at each reassessment. Strength testing showed mild residual weakness in external rotation at the most recent evaluation.

At discharge, the patient reported substantial but incomplete recovery, with occasional discomfort during overhead activities and lifting. Continued home exercise and activity pacing were recommended. Follow-up care will be arranged if symptoms worsen or fail to continue improving.
